<h2 id="整体框架" class="heading-element">
 <a href="#%e6%95%b4%e4%bd%93%e6%a1%86%e6%9e%b6" class="heading-mark"></a><span>整体框架</span>

 <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>

</h2><p>xenomai3的整体结构如下
<img loading="lazy" src="../../attachment/xenomai3%e6%95%b4%e4%bd%93%e7%bb%93%e6%9e%84.png" alt="../../attachment/xenomai3整体结构.png" srcset="../../attachment/xenomai3%e6%95%b4%e4%bd%93%e7%bb%93%e6%9e%84.png?size=small, ../../attachment/xenomai3%e6%95%b4%e4%bd%93%e7%bb%93%e6%9e%84.png?size=medium 1.5x, ../../attachment/xenomai3%e6%95%b4%e4%bd%93%e7%bb%93%e6%9e%84.png?size=large 2x" data-title="../../attachment/xenomai3整体结构.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/>
<img loading="lazy" src="../../attachment/Xenomai3%e6%95%b4%e4%bd%93%e7%bb%93%e6%9e%842.png" alt="../../attachment/Xenomai3整体结构2.png" srcset="../../attachment/Xenomai3%e6%95%b4%e4%bd%93%e7%bb%93%e6%9e%842.png?size=small, ../../attachment/Xenomai3%e6%95%b4%e4%bd%93%e7%bb%93%e6%9e%842.png?size=medium 1.5x, ../../attachment/Xenomai3%e6%95%b4%e4%bd%93%e7%bb%93%e6%9e%842.png?size=large 2x" data-title="../../attachment/Xenomai3整体结构2.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<hr>
<p><strong>在内核空间，在标准linux基础上添加一个实时内核Cobalt，得益于基于ADEOS（Adaptive Domain Environment for Operating System)，使Cobalt在内核空间与linux内核并存，并把标准的Linux内核作为实时内核中的一个idle进程在实时内核上调度</strong></p>
<p>ADEOS ,其核心思想是Domain,也就是范围的意思，linux内核有linux内核的范围，cobalt内核有cobalt内核的范围。</p>
<ul>
<li>两个内核管理各自范围内的应用、驱动、中断</li>
<li>两个domain之间有优先级之分，cobalt内核优先级高于linux内核</li>
<li>I-pipe优先处理高优先级域的中断，来保证高优先级域的实时性</li>
<li>高优先级域可以通过I-pipe 向低优先级域发送各类事件等
<strong>在用户空间</strong>，添加针对实时应用优化的库&ndash;libcobalt，libcobalt提供POSIX接口给应用空间实时任务使用，应用通过libcobalt让实时内核cobalt提供服务。
<strong>驱动方面</strong>，xenomai提供实时驱动框架模型RTDM（Real-Time Driver Model）,专门用于Cobalt内核，基于RTDM进行实时设备驱动开发，为实时应用提供实时驱动。RTDM将驱动分为2类：</li>
<li>字符设备 如串口等</li>
<li>协议设备 如UDP/TCP CAN
<strong>中断方面</strong>，I-Pipe(interrupt Pipeline)分发Linux和Xenomai之间的中断，并以Domain优先级顺序传递中断。I-Pipe传递中断如下图所示，对于实时内核注册的中断，中断产生后能够直接得到处理，保证实时性。对于linux的中断，先将中断记录在i-log，等实时任务让出CPU后，linux得到运行，该中断才得到处理。
<img loading="lazy" src="../../attachment/Xenomai%e4%b8%ad%e6%96%ad1.png" alt="../../attachment/Xenomai中断1.png" srcset="../../attachment/Xenomai%e4%b8%ad%e6%96%ad1.png?size=small, ../../attachment/Xenomai%e4%b8%ad%e6%96%ad1.png?size=medium 1.5x, ../../attachment/Xenomai%e4%b8%ad%e6%96%ad1.png?size=large 2x" data-title="../../attachment/Xenomai中断1.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>更多信息可参考如下链接 <a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/wsg1100/p/12833126.html"target="_blank" rel="external nofollow noopener noreferrer">https://www.cnblogs.com/wsg1100/p/12833126.html</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="其他linux实时化方案" class="heading-element">
 <a href="#%e5%85%b6%e4%bb%96linux%e5%ae%9e%e6%97%b6%e5%8c%96%e6%96%b9%e6%a1%88" class="heading-mark"></a><span>其他Linux实时化方案</span>
 <a href="#%e5%85%b6%e4%bb%96linux%e5%ae%9e%e6%97%b6%e5%8c%96%e6%96%b9%e6%a1%88" class="heading-mark-link">
 <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
 </a>
</h2><p><img loading="lazy" src="../../attachment/Linux%e5%ae%9e%e6%97%b6%e5%8c%96%e6%96%b9%e6%a1%88.png" alt="../../attachment/Linux实时化方案.png" srcset="../../attachment/Linux%e5%ae%9e%e6%97%b6%e5%8c%96%e6%96%b9%e6%a1%88.png?size=small, ../../attachment/Linux%e5%ae%9e%e6%97%b6%e5%8c%96%e6%96%b9%e6%a1%88.png?size=medium 1.5x, ../../attachment/Linux%e5%ae%9e%e6%97%b6%e5%8c%96%e6%96%b9%e6%a1%88.png?size=large 2x" data-title="../../attachment/Linux实时化方案.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/>
PREEMPT-RT方案主要缺点：通过修改Linux内核，难以保证实时进程的执行不会遭到非实时进程所进行的不可预测活动的干扰
<img loading="lazy" src="../../attachment/Linux%e5%ae%9e%e6%97%b6%e5%8c%96%e6%96%b9%e6%a1%88%e5%8f%8c%e5%86%85%e6%a0%b8.png" alt="../../attachment/Linux实时化方案双内核.png" srcset="../../attachment/Linux%e5%ae%9e%e6%97%b6%e5%8c%96%e6%96%b9%e6%a1%88%e5%8f%8c%e5%86%85%e6%a0%b8.png?size=small, ../../attachment/Linux%e5%ae%9e%e6%97%b6%e5%8c%96%e6%96%b9%e6%a1%88%e5%8f%8c%e5%86%85%e6%a0%b8.png?size=medium 1.5x, ../../attachment/Linux%e5%ae%9e%e6%97%b6%e5%8c%96%e6%96%b9%e6%a1%88%e5%8f%8c%e5%86%85%e6%a0%b8.png?size=large 2x" data-title="../../attachment/Linux实时化方案双内核.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="../../attachment/Linux%e5%ae%9e%e6%97%b6%e5%8c%96%e6%96%b9%e6%a1%88%e5%af%b9%e6%af%94.png" alt="../../attachment/Linux实时化方案对比.png" srcset="../../attachment/Linux%e5%ae%9e%e6%97%b6%e5%8c%96%e6%96%b9%e6%a1%88%e5%af%b9%e6%af%94.png?size=small, ../../attachment/Linux%e5%ae%9e%e6%97%b6%e5%8c%96%e6%96%b9%e6%a1%88%e5%af%b9%e6%af%94.png?size=medium 1.5x, ../../attachment/Linux%e5%ae%9e%e6%97%b6%e5%8c%96%e6%96%b9%e6%a1%88%e5%af%b9%e6%af%94.png?size=large 2x" data-title="../../attachment/Linux实时化方案对比.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/>
<strong>Linux实时化如此艰难的主要原因是Linux中有非常明显的内核态和用户态的区分（本身从用户态陷入内核态就是个实时性很差的机制），内核态中各种临界区是不能抢占的，哪怕打完RT补丁，还是有很多地方不能抢占，比如spinlock默认禁止抢占（整个内核态有10万+地方使用），同时硬中断的执行时间不确定，软中断总是抢占应用上下文等等影响任务调度时间的地方。</strong></p>

</h2><p>这是一个基于龙芯LoongArch架构的**异构多核处理器(AMP - Asymmetric Multi-Processing)**框架，实现了Linux系统与裸机程序在双核系统中的协作处理。该框架允许CPU0运行完整的Linux系统，而CPU1运行高性能的rewors程序(理论上也可以是别的程序，比如vxworks的，只要BSP做好即可，毕竟CPU不会去区分到底是什么程序)，两者通过共享内存和核间中断进行通信(上层设计为虚拟网卡)。</p>

<li>iperf3测试时某些情况时会出现系统崩溃的情况，详情参考专门的测试文档</li>
